recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core FHIR source follow-up is indicated unless a new reproducible publisher bug is filed against the current IG Publisher repository.
issue_request: The Published/Persuasive Jira issue reported that IG Publisher output for derived profiles could add or replace a terminology binding link with an '(unbound)' link when the constrained binding strength was not example.
initial_application: No FHIR source commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-17117 was found. The linked Zulip thread shows the report was opened from IG Publisher output and narrowed to derived-profile rendering, while follow-up discussion and Jira comments indicate the symptom improved and had not recurred for years.
additional_context: Current core source keeps Device and HealthcareService as active resources, and Device.type is explicitly bound; there is no current core source literal '(unbound)' rendering text to fix. FHIR git history removed the in-repository IG Publisher assets and old igtools Java code after the publisher moved out, and HL7/fhir-ig-publisher is the current publisher source repository.
reconciliation: No FHIR source file was changed. The issue was decided as external-repo because any remaining rendering correction belongs to the IG Publisher project rather than the current FHIR specification checkout, and the Jira comments direct any recurrence to HL7/fhir-ig-publisher.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive tooling issue reporting IG Publisher '(unbound)' rendering for derived profiles, with later comments saying it was old and not recurring.
evidence_items.learned: The final Jira record supports closing the seed without a current FHIR core source edit and points any recurrence to HL7/fhir-ig-publisher.

evidence_items.summary: The original discussion reported IG Publisher output replacing a real terminology binding with an 'unbound' link in derived profiles.
evidence_items.learned: The problem was publisher rendering behavior, not missing normative source text or a resource binding request.

evidence_items.summary: The AU issue list records FHIR-17117 as an IG Publisher issue, later notes it looked fixed, and explains some remaining HealthcareService unbound displays as genuine STU3 unbound elements.
evidence_items.learned: Community follow-up narrows the concern to tooling/cache behavior and does not justify a current core spec edit.

evidence_items.summary: Device.type remains explicitly bound with strength example to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/device-type, and Device/HealthcareService are active resources in fhir.ini.
evidence_items.learned: The current build-scope resource definitions are not missing the binding that the old publisher rendered incorrectly.

evidence_items.summary: FHIR history removed IG Publisher test assets in 2019 after the publisher moved to Maven and removed remaining old igtools Java code in 2021.
evidence_items.learned: The active IG Publisher implementation is outside the current FHIR source checkout.

evidence_items.locator: External publisher and negative source/community checks
